## Key Requirements


CCM pays clinicians for coordination work outside the exam room, and patients must have two or more chronic conditions expected to last at least 12 months and be at significant risk of decline
.

## Additional Revenue Opportunities


CCM can be billed concurrently with RPM and BHI when documentation and time requirements are met independently, creating layered revenue of approximately $200 to $300+ per patient per month
.

Note that actual reimbursement rates vary by geographic location and provider type.
